formal: shift_trust(current, target)[i] == current[i] + (target[i] - current[i]) * damping for all i
damping == 0 => shift_trust(current, target) == current and damping == 1 => shift_trust(current, target) == target

precondition: len(current) == len(target) and current and all(current[i] <= current[i+1] for i in range(len(current)-1)) and all(target[i] <= target[i+1] for i in range(len(target)-1))
formal: all(shift_trust(current, target)[i] <= shift_trust(current, target)[i+1] for i in range(len(shift_trust(current, target))-1))

precondition: len(current) == len(target) and current and all(0 <= current[i] <= 1 for i in range(len(current))) and all(0 <= target[i] <= 1 for i in range(len(target)))
formal: all(0 <= shift_trust(current, target)[i] <= 1 for i in range(len(shift_trust(current, target))))

precondition: len(current) == len(target) and current and current == target
len(current) == len(target) and current and scalar != 0
formal: shift_trust([c * scalar for c in current], [t * scalar for t in target]) == [s * scalar for s in shift_trust(current, target)]
